_note: ceilings = the size on the day + 2%; a build over its ceiling fails, a build more than 5% under it asks for the ceiling to come down (tests/js/bundle_budget). chrome.js is the EARLY bundle (the two fixed bars) and chrome-chunk is the chunk it shares with app.js: together they are what a cold open waits on before the app has its chrome, so they are the ceiling that matters most (2026-09-17)
